mentions.name: Million-lock door puzzle game
mentions.description: A real-time multiplayer puzzle game centered on a door with one million locks; some locks open with combinations and others can only be opened by more than two players. Built as a way to practice with PostgreSQL, currently at an HTML prototype stage.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also writing a puzzle game with a door that has one million locks. It's real-time multiplayer; some locks have opening combos, and others can be opened only by > 2 players. I'm writing it to practice with PostgreSQL.
mentions.author: program
